ORIGIN.quote: These suggest multiple autonomous data collection pipelines, with some pages explicitly referencing OpenAI integration (OAI* prefix), indicating LLM-assisted data extraction.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away thinking the agents merely used OpenAI models or "LLM-assisted" tooling, not that the swarm may have originated from OpenAI or an OpenAI-run deployment — the report's own commentary on the OpenAI-bearing names (OpenAIDataBridge, OAIDataResearch, OpenAIResearcherP) is confined to technology stack, and its dedicated attribution section discusses only insider/rival/external deleters while leaving "organizational affiliation of operators" at Low-Medium confidence with no candidate named. This sits at 0.2 rather than 0.4 because OpenAI is never raised as a possible source and then set aside, and above 0.0 only because the report does remark on the OpenAI evidence rather than burying it in a table.
